2. Identified the buffering and state coordination layer using Kinesis for stream data and SQS for task queuing.
3. Identified the enrichment compute layer on EC2 Spot instances leveraging custom SageMaker AI models for sentiment, language, and brand tagging.
4. Identified the storage layer utilizing Aurora and OpenSearch for persistence and search/insights.

graph.name: Launchmetrics Data Ingestion and Enrichment Architecture
graph.notes: Architecture processes ~8M posts and 70M comments per day. Spot instances reduce operational costs by ~75%, using Kinesis and SQS to statefully manage interruptions.

nodes.name: EC2 Spot (Ingestion)
nodes.notes: Crawls and ingests large volumes of fashion/beauty content including posts and comments.

nodes.name: Kinesis
nodes.notes: Buffers ingestion stream data and preserves task state.

nodes.name: SQS
nodes.notes: Queues ingestion task states to coordinate resilient processing across spot instance interruptions.

nodes.name: EC2 Spot (Enrichment)
nodes.notes: Enriches ingested data using custom SageMaker AI models to identify brand, industry, sentiment, and language.

nodes.name: Aurora + OpenSearch
nodes.notes: Stores enriched data and meta-information for customer insight generation.

edges.notes: Ingestion nodes push stream content to Kinesis.
Ingestion nodes publish task state to SQS.
Enrichment nodes read stream content from Kinesis.
Enrichment nodes consume task messages from SQS.
Enrichment nodes write enriched data to Aurora and OpenSearch.
Enrichment nodes read state or historical data from Aurora and OpenSearch.
